roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Identity Graph Platform Products

bullets: Extend and execute the strategy for Socure's Identity Graph products in collaboration with several core partners
Translate advanced graph capabilities into clear, sellable products with compelling value propositions.
Help to establish scalable pricing models, packaging, and usage-based constructs aligned with customer value.
Own the roadmap, definition, and launch of proactive identity notification products, from first beta customer through general availability.
Define the customer-facing event contract: what the notification contains, its lifecycle semantics, and how customers consume and act on it.
Design a systematic customer feedback loop so every notification we send makes the next one better.
Begin the product definition for the next event types on the roadmap, where the customer problem is more open-ended and the framing work is still to be done.
Own the Watchlist product roadmap, balancing compliance accuracy, customer needs, and engineering capacity.
Translate market trends, regulatory changes, and customer feedback into product priorities and requirements.
Define and track key product metrics: screening accuracy, false positive rates, match coverage, and customer outcomes.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Core Fraud Services

bullets: Conduct ongoing customer discovery and feedback loops to validate hypotheses and inform product direction.
